findings: ACCEPT exact source: cda8c30 HEAD remained clean before/after both native captures. Independently hashed all 1929 inventory entries, including scripts, assets, fonts, shaders, tests/tools and actual Godot4.7.2 binary. Whole and per-movie inventories match before/after; original summary SHA matches outer receipt. This review performs no native engine run.

ACCEPT actual trajectories: both original validate_region_capture calls independently return []; 1075 growth and1102 high-return physics ticks have actual support landings, no manual Motor steps or injected mid-route resources/positions. Independently checked each hook leg has queued real grapple requests preceding its actual contact events. Growth crown anchor contact tick648 and kick655 precede first saved-open tick655; high-return intentionally does not open the optional arena gate.

ACCEPT sampled pixels: actual frame662/11.033s and669/11.15s show contact/kick at brass ring; frame1000/16.667s shows body across arena seam and correct Queen HUD; frame1075/17.917s shows grounded body and old-branch attack warning. Earlier branch frames lack premature Boss HUD. These samples show arena approach, not a completed Boss fight.

ACCEPT cache and return pixels: frame856/14.267s and858/14.3s show real two-choice reward modal; actual logged mouse press/release hits the original Purple Vessel button. Frame862/14.367s shows acquired item and HP5/6.5 (max HP increase without healing); frame1008/16.8s shows supported camp return, frame1110/18.5s shows supported junction return. Capture claims and fresh-state reload agree. No claim that decoded movie frame equals physics tick.

ACCEPT encoding: independently ffprobed actual AVI decoded frame counts1090/1121 at1280x720/60fps and rehashed AVI/MP4/native logs/captures/all sampled PNGs. Both complete MP4 files independently software-decoded without errors. Durations18.167/18.683s describe playback, not real-time performance. Last teardown frames remain in full movies. No audio listening performed; capture used Dummy audio backend.

Validator boundary explicitly retained: deleting grapple request logs alone still passes the existing region validator because it checks accepted hook events rather than every request journal entry. Current original artifacts contain those requests and were independently checked per leg; no claim of complete request-log deletion resistance. Removing actual hook contact events, cache claim, return completion or modal mouse proof is rejected. No source edits proposed by this bounded review.
Old failed CI, old wrong-map captures and leaked-negative records are unchanged and not retroactively accepted. New CI/browser/device/art/user acceptance is separate.
